title: Nearest Fraction
statementMd:
You are given three positive integers $*x*, *y*, *n*$. Your task is to find the nearest fraction to fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d9049b74dfcebaef5774f475b1e3ef4ed39cfc63.png) whose denominator is no more than $*n*$.

Formally, you should find such pair of integers $*a*, *b*$ $(1 ≤ *b* ≤ *n*; 0 ≤ *a*)$ that the value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4bb27e47b8ebb13e650f4f8a897d41377cf4360.png) is as minimal as possible.

If there are multiple "nearest" fractions, choose the one with the minimum denominator. If there are multiple "nearest" fractions with the minimum denominator, choose the one with the minimum numerator.

## Input

A single line contains three integers $*x*, *y*, *n*$ $(1 ≤ *x*, *y*, *n* ≤ 10^{5})$.

## Output

Print the required fraction in the format "$*a*$/$*b*$" (without quotes).
statementZhMd:
给定三个正整数 $*x*, *y*, *n*$。你的任务是找到一个分母不超过 $*n*$ 的分数，使其尽可能接近分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d9049b74dfcebaef5774f475b1e3ef4ed39cfc63.png)。

形式化地说，你需要找到一对整数 $*a*, *b*$ $(1 ≤ *b* ≤ *n*; 0 ≤ *a*)$，使得数值 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4bb27e47b8ebb13e650f4f8a897d41377cf4360.png) 尽可能小。

如果存在多个“最接近”的分数，选择分母最小的那个。如果在分母最小的“最接近”分数中仍有多个，选择分子最小的那个。

## 输入格式

一行包含三个整数 $*x*, *y*, *n*$ $(1 ≤ *x*, *y*, *n* ≤ 10^{5})$。

## 输出格式

按照 "$*a*$/$*b*$" 的格式输出所求分数（不含引号）。
